quests.instruction: A bus calls at Stop A at 8:00, Stop B at 8:12, Stop C at 8:27 and Stop D at 8:41. How long does the bus take to go from Stop B to Stop D?
quests.hint: Count from 8:12 up to 8:30 first, then on to 8:41.
quests.explanation: 8:12 to 8:30 is 18 minutes, and 8:30 to 8:41 is 11 more. 18 + 11 = 29 minutes.
quests.funFact: The Hubble Space Telescope circles the Earth about once every 95 minutes.

quests.instruction: A tram calls at Stop P at 3:05, Stop Q at 3:22, Stop R at 3:35 and Stop S at 3:58. Which part of the journey takes the longest?
quests.hint: Find the time taken by each leg of the trip.
quests.explanation: P to Q takes 17 minutes, Q to R takes 13 minutes and R to S takes 23 minutes. The longest part is R to S.
quests.funFact: On busy lines, trains in the Tokyo subway can arrive every two or three minutes.

quests.instruction: A bus is due at Stop A at 8:00 and at Stop B at 8:12. Today it is 6 minutes late at Stop A but makes up 2 minutes on the way to Stop B. When does it reach Stop B?
quests.hint: Start from the late time at Stop A, then use the shorter journey time.
quests.explanation: At Stop A the bus is at 8:06. The journey to Stop B normally takes 12 minutes, but today it takes 10. So it reaches Stop B at 8:16.
quests.funFact: The Trans-Siberian railway journey across Russia takes about six days.

quests.instruction: A train leaves at 11:20 AM and arrives at 1:05 PM. How long is the journey?
quests.hint: Count to noon first, then on to 1:05.
quests.explanation: 11:20 AM to 12:00 PM is 40 minutes, and 12:00 to 1:05 PM is 1 hour 5 minutes. 40 + 65 = 105 minutes, which is 1 hour 45 minutes.
quests.funFact: The supersonic plane Concorde could fly across the Atlantic Ocean in under three and a half hours.

quests.instruction: Journey 1 runs 10:50 AM to 12:20 PM. Journey 2 runs 11:15 AM to 12:40 PM. Journey 3 runs 11:40 AM to 1:15 PM. Which journey is the shortest?
quests.hint: Find the length of each journey. They all cross noon.
quests.explanation: Journey 1 takes 1 hour 30 minutes, Journey 2 takes 1 hour 25 minutes and Journey 3 takes 1 hour 35 minutes. So Journey 2 is the shortest.
quests.funFact: Pilots around the world use one shared clock called UTC, so that every flight plan uses the same time.

quests.instruction: You must arrive by 1:00 PM and the journey takes 1 hour 50 minutes. What is the latest time you can leave?
quests.hint: Go back from 1:00 PM by the length of the journey.
quests.explanation: 1 hour before 1:00 PM is 12:00 noon, and 50 more minutes back is 11:10 AM.
quests.funFact: The Olympic Games take place every four years.

quests.instruction: A ride has a 35-minute queue and then lasts 5 minutes. Sam joins the queue at 2:50 PM. When does his ride end?
quests.hint: Add the queue time first, then the ride.
quests.explanation: 2:50 PM plus 35 minutes is 3:25 PM. Then 5 minutes more makes 3:30 PM.
quests.funFact: Some roller coasters last only one to three minutes, even though the queue can take an hour.

quests.instruction: Each ride has a 20-minute queue and lasts 5 minutes. Eva joins her first queue at 1:10 PM and goes on three rides, one after another. When does her third ride end?
quests.hint: How long does one ride take altogether, including its queue?
quests.explanation: Each ride takes 20 + 5 = 25 minutes. Three rides take 75 minutes, which is 1 hour 15 minutes. 1:10 PM plus 1 hour 15 minutes is 2:25 PM.
quests.funFact: Mathematicians study queues, and the first queueing theory was developed in 1909 to improve telephone calls.

quests.instruction: A park's last ride must be finished by 5:00 PM. The queue takes 30 minutes and the ride lasts 6 minutes. What is the latest time to join the queue?
quests.hint: Find the total time for the queue and the ride, then count back from 5:00.
quests.explanation: 30 + 6 = 36 minutes. 36 minutes before 5:00 PM is 4:24 PM.
quests.funFact: Many parks and attractions announce a last-entry time that is earlier than their closing time.

quests.instruction: Sessions start every 40 minutes, beginning at 9:00 AM. What time does the sixth session start?
quests.hint: List the start times: begin at 9:00 and add 40 minutes each time.
quests.explanation: The start times are 9:00, 9:40, 10:20, 11:00, 11:40 and 12:20. The sixth session starts at 12:20 PM.
quests.funFact: A metronome set to 60 beats per minute ticks once every second.

quests.instruction: A shuttle leaves at 7:10, 7:35 and 8:00, and keeps going every 25 minutes. Which of these is a shuttle time?
quests.hint: Continue the pattern by adding 25 minutes each time.
quests.explanation: After 8:00, adding 25 minutes gives 8:25. The times 8:20 and 8:30 do not fit the pattern.
quests.funFact: Trees grow one ring each year, so the rings inside a trunk can be counted to find the tree's age.

quests.instruction: A ship's bell sounds at every half hour. It first sounds at 12:30. How many times has it sounded by the time the clock shows 2:00?
quests.hint: List the bell times one by one, starting at 12:30.
quests.explanation: The bell sounds at 12:30, 1:00, 1:30 and 2:00. That is 4 times.
quests.funFact: On old sailing ships, a bell was rung every half hour to tell the crew how much of their watch had passed.

quests.instruction: Clock A has its short hand just past 2 and its long hand on 6. Clock B has its short hand almost on 5 and its long hand on 9. How much time passes from Clock A to Clock B?
quests.hint: Read each clock as a digital time first.
quests.explanation: Clock A shows 2:30 and Clock B shows 4:45. 2:30 to 4:30 is 2 hours, and 4:30 to 4:45 is 15 more minutes. Altogether it is 2 hours 15 minutes.
quests.funFact: Adult mayflies live for only about a day, and some live for just a few hours.

quests.instruction: A film starts at twenty to six and a second film starts at quarter past eight. How long is it between the two starts?
quests.hint: Turn the words into digital times, then count on from the earlier one.
quests.explanation: Twenty to six is 5:40 and quarter past eight is 8:15. 5:40 to 8:00 is 2 hours 20 minutes, and 8:00 to 8:15 is 15 more. Altogether 2 hours 35 minutes.
quests.funFact: In the 1700s, the English clockmaker John Harrison built a very accurate sea clock that helped sailors find their position.

quests.instruction: Which time is exactly halfway between 2:10 and 3:00?
quests.hint: Find the gap between the two times, then take half of it.
quests.explanation: From 2:10 to 3:00 is 50 minutes. Half of 50 is 25 minutes, and 2:10 plus 25 minutes is 2:35.
quests.funFact: The astronomical clock in Bern, Switzerland, was built in 1405 and still shows the time today.

quests.instruction: It is 4:25 PM. A film started 1 hour 10 minutes ago and lasts 2 hours. How much of the film is left?
quests.hint: Find the start time, then the end time, then count to the end.
quests.explanation: The film started at 3:15 PM and lasts 2 hours, so it ends at 5:15 PM. From 4:25 PM to 5:15 PM is 50 minutes.
quests.funFact: A day on Saturn lasts only about 10 and a half hours.

quests.instruction: It is 11:40 AM. The next bus comes in 35 minutes, and the bus after that comes 20 minutes later. When does the second bus come?
quests.hint: Find the first bus time, then add the 20 minutes.
quests.explanation: 35 minutes after 11:40 AM is 12:15 PM. The second bus comes 20 minutes later, at 12:35 PM.
quests.funFact: Phones and computers keep the correct time by checking with time servers over the internet.

quests.instruction: It is 9:05 AM. Which happened more recently: something 75 minutes ago, or something 1 hour 10 minutes ago?
options: They happened at the same time
quests.hint: Compare the two lengths using the same unit: minutes.
quests.explanation: 1 hour 10 minutes is 70 minutes. Something 70 minutes ago is more recent than something 75 minutes ago.
quests.funFact: Geologists read the layers in rocks to work out how long ago something happened.

quests.instruction: Each worksheet takes 15 minutes. How many worksheets can Noor finish in 2 hours 15 minutes?
quests.hint: Change the time into minutes first, then think about how many 15s fit.
quests.explanation: 2 hours 15 minutes is 135 minutes. 135 ÷ 15 = 9 worksheets.
quests.funFact: A good typing speed for an adult is around 40 words per minute.

quests.instruction: Kabir reads 5 pages in 10 minutes. At the same speed, how long will 20 pages take?
quests.hint: 20 pages is how many times as many as 5 pages?
quests.explanation: 20 pages is 4 times as many as 5 pages, so the time is 4 × 10 = 40 minutes.
quests.funFact: Children usually read about 100 to 150 words every minute.

quests.instruction: A tap fills one bucket every 3 minutes. How long will it take to fill 12 buckets?
quests.hint: Each bucket needs 3 minutes. How many buckets are there?
quests.explanation: 12 buckets × 3 minutes = 36 minutes.
quests.funFact: An Olympic swimming pool holds about 2.5 million litres of water, so it takes days to fill.

quests.instruction: Trains leave at 7:15, 7:50 and 8:25, and they arrive at 7:45, 8:20 and 8:55. What is true about the journeys?
quests.hint: Subtract each leaving time from its arriving time.
quests.explanation: 7:15 to 7:45, 7:50 to 8:20 and 8:25 to 8:55 are each 30 minutes. It is the gap between departures that is 35 minutes.
quests.funFact: The world's first underground railway opened in London in 1863.

quests.instruction: Buses leave at 4:05, 4:30 and 4:55, and keep leaving at the same gap. What time is the next bus after 4:55?
quests.hint: Find the gap between buses first.
quests.explanation: The gap between buses is 25 minutes. 4:55 plus 25 minutes is 5:20.
quests.funFact: Timetables with a steady gap, such as every 25 minutes, are easier to remember than uneven ones.

quests.instruction: Slow train: leaves 9:05, arrives 9:50. Fast train: leaves 9:20, arrives 9:55. Anna reaches the station at 9:10. Which train should she take to arrive earliest?
quests.hint: Check which train has not left yet at 9:10.
quests.explanation: The slow train left at 9:05, so Anna has missed it. The fast train leaves at 9:20 and arrives at 9:55.
quests.funFact: Some train timetables print fast and slow services in different colours to help travellers choose.

quests.instruction: A lesson ended at 11:15 AM. A 10-minute break followed, and then another lesson of 40 minutes. When did the second lesson end?
quests.hint: Start from 11:15, add the break, and then add the lesson.
quests.explanation: 11:15 plus 10 minutes is 11:25. Then 40 minutes later is 12:05 PM.
quests.funFact: In many countries the school year has between 180 and 220 days.

quests.instruction: A show begins at 7:00 PM. The interval starts at 7:50 and lasts 20 minutes, and the second half lasts 45 minutes. When does the show end?
quests.hint: Find when the interval ends, then add the second half.
quests.explanation: The interval ends at 8:10 PM. The second half lasts 45 minutes, so the show ends at 8:55 PM.
quests.funFact: Theatre intervals usually last 15 to 20 minutes.

quests.instruction: A train leaves at 10:05 AM and the journey takes 2 hours 50 minutes. Then there is a 15-minute walk to the hotel. When does the traveller reach the hotel?
quests.hint: Find the arrival time of the train first, then add the walk.
quests.explanation: 10:05 AM plus 2 hours is 12:05 PM, and 50 more minutes makes 12:55 PM. The 15-minute walk ends at 1:10 PM.
quests.funFact: Airlines often add spare minutes to the scheduled flight time, so that planes can arrive on time even after small delays.

quests.instruction: Bus A runs 6:15 to 6:58. Bus B runs 6:30 to 7:05. Bus C runs 6:45 to 7:15. Which bus has the longest journey?
quests.hint: Work out how long each journey takes.
quests.explanation: Bus A takes 43 minutes, Bus B takes 35 minutes and Bus C takes 30 minutes. So Bus A takes the longest.
quests.funFact: In British English a list of departure times is a timetable, while in American English it is often called a schedule.

quests.instruction: Pia reads for 35 minutes, draws for 1 hour 5 minutes and plays for 50 minutes. How long is that altogether?
quests.hint: Change everything into minutes before you add.
quests.explanation: 35 + 65 + 50 = 150 minutes, which is 2 hours 30 minutes.
quests.funFact: Changing every length of time into minutes is the safest way to add up a long list.

quests.instruction: It is 3:25 PM. A match started 50 minutes ago and lasts 90 minutes. How long is left?
quests.hint: Find the start time, and then the end time.
quests.explanation: The match started at 2:35 PM and ends at 4:05 PM. From 3:25 PM to 4:05 PM is 40 minutes.
quests.funFact: A baseball game has no clock. It ends when all the innings have been played.
